summary: A complete HUST-themed graduation invitation webpage inspired by the TikTok Dr.Gifter style. Features: envelope opening animation on first load, floating vinyl disc music player (spinning when playing), countdown timer, personal letter section, Google Maps embed, wish/guestbook form with local storage, thank-you section with dark background, confetti on load. Color scheme: HUST dark red (#990000) + gold (#D4AF37) on clean off-white. No floral decorations - replaced with geometric tech-inspired elements.
